answer_1.quote: We adopt long dialogue contexts –14 turns on average – to allow for more detailed conversational background to both the reflection generator and the annotator... we fine‑tune ... to generate synthetic reflections ...
answer_1.outputs: therapist reflections (paraphrased or expanded client statements)

answer_2.quote: We measure the lexical and semantic diversity of synthetic reflections from GPT-2/BART/GPT-3 using Self‑BLEU and average pairwise semantic similarity...

answer_4.quote: We recruit 9 laypeople ... and 9 experts ... For each reflection, the annotator chooses Yes/No regarding whether it is coherent. If the answer is No, the annotator selects one or more error categories.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators read the dialogue context, then mark each reflection as Coherent (Yes) or Incoherent (No) and, when Incoherent, select applicable error categories (Malformed, Dialogue‑contradicting, Parroting, Off‑topic, On‑topic but unverifiable).
